strategy_roster.name: Daily BreakPoint
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open * 1.02 and close - open >= 0.5 * atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: A 2% move from the current bar open and a body of at least half ATR(14) proxy the separate daily-open and body-size rules; 2% is an explicit fallback because pips are unsupplied. The daily stream, pips stops, trailing step, and session state are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Aurora Divergence
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(close,20) < 0 and roc(volume,20) > 0 and zscore(close,20) > -2 and zscore(close,20) < 2 and close > ema(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: Falling 20-bar price with rising 20-bar volume approximates price/OBV divergence, while z-score(20) and EMA(50) supply normalization and trend filters. All lengths are fallbacks; higher-timeframe regression, cooldown, ATR-risk, and hold-time state cannot be reproduced.

strategy_roster.name: Adx Volume
strategy_roster.entry_long: adx(high,low,close,14) > 25 and volume_ratio(volume,20) > 1 and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: ADX(14)>25, above-average 20-bar volume, and a bullish candle translate the documented long-side strength proxy. The source does not state its direction rule; ATR-based absolute protection is not a fixed percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Multi-Timeframe Bollinger Bands
strategy_roster.notes: The disabled-by-default single-timeframe Bollinger(20,2) lower/upper extremes approximate the primary and higher-timeframe pierces. The optional EMA(200) filter is omitted; 2% is the documented stop value.

strategy_roster.name: Exp RSIOMA
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) of SMA(14) proxies RSIOMA; recovery within the documented -20/+20 channel drives a Breakdown-style long state, with the opposite slope or upper threshold exiting. The 21-period signal smoother and other selectable modes are omitted; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Time
strategy_roster.notes: The default zero-tick condition reduces to high>open, and its failure exits. The 20-second persistence, intrabar updates, and reset-on-new-bar timing require clock/intrabar state unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Engulfing & Pin Bar Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > open and high > donchian_high_prev(high,1) and close - open >= 2 * (high - close)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish candle with a lower shadow at least twice its body and a prior-high break proxies the hammer branch; engulfing needs shifted OHLC and is omitted. RiskPercent=0.02 is represented as 2%, with the documented 5R long target represented as 10%.

strategy_roster.name: SpaceX Delete StopLoss TakeProfit Button
strategy_roster.notes: The utility only removes protective orders on existing positions and never opens or closes positions, so the impossible guard preserves no entries. Portfolio/order polling, manual trigger state, and timer behavior are unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: Visual Trader Simulator Edition
strategy_roster.notes: The indicator-free demonstration opens one configured long immediately, approximated by the first positive-price bar; its negative-price guard supplies the impossible closure. Absolute-price protection and configurable direction are not represented in the long-only DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Rsi Stochastic
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14)<30 with a rising one-bar RSI change proxies RSI and an oversold stochastic beginning to turn; the exact oscillator exits at 50. Stochastic periods and the 2% stop are documented, while no take profit is supplied.
